title: Real-valued coefficient extension
statement: Given a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of the $n$ coordinates and a rational coefficient for each member, define the real coefficient of a subset $S$ to be its assigned coefficient, viewed as a real number, when $S\in\mathcal F$, and $0$ otherwise.
